final: SELECT AVG(item_average_ratio) AS average_per_item_average_ratio, AVG(invoice_line_item_count) AS average_per_item_line_item_count FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.product_price IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 THEN 1.0 * ili.product_price / ili.derived_total_cost END) AS item_average_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS invoice_line_item_count FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id)
